title: Medical CT Slice Viewer (Orthogonal Slices + Window Width/Level + Volume Rendering)
prompt:
Use Three.js to implement procedurally generated medical CT-style volume data and an orthogonal slice viewer.

[Three.js Import Method (Must Be Followed Strictly)]
Use the following import map in <head>, and import via ES Modules in <script type="module">:
<script type="importmap">
{ "imports": {
    "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/"
} }
</script>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';
</script>

[Volume Data]
(1) Procedurally generate a 64×64×64 scalar volume (uint8 or a 0–255 floating-point mapping is acceptable) that simulates a brain-like structure: multiple layers of concentric ellipsoidal shells with different radial sizes and ellipticities, different densities between shells, and a small amount of pseudorandom noise added to produce a natural texture.
(2) Create three orthogonal slice planes: Axial (XY, normal +Z), Coronal (XZ, normal +Y), and Sagittal (YZ, normal +X). Each must use PlaneGeometry + MeshBasicMaterial/ShaderMaterial, upload the current slice's grayscale/pseudocolor texture through a DataTexture (or equivalent method), and update when its slider changes.

[Controls]
(3) id="axialSlice": range 0–63, controls the axial slice index (Z).
(4) id="coronalSlice": range 0–63, controls the coronal slice index (Y).
(5) id="sagittalSlice": range 0–63, controls the sagittal slice index (X).
(6) id="windowWidth": range 1–255, window width (contrast).
(7) id="windowCenter": range 0–255, window level (brightness center). Window width and level map voxel intensity for display using the typical CT windowing formula (v - center) / width, then clamp the result to [0,1] before applying color.
(8) id="colormap": <select> with at least the three option strings grayscale, hot, and cool, switching between pseudocolor and grayscale mappings.
(9) id="volumeToggle": a toggle (checkbox or equivalent). When enabled, add a translucent 3D volume display to the scene. This may use multiple translucent planes stacked along the third axis, or single-pass ray stepping/simple ray marching, provided performance is acceptable. When disabled, retain only the three slice planes and guide lines.

[Visuals and Interaction]
(10) Draw crosshair lines on each slice plane (or scene-level lines) to indicate the intersection lines/point of the three slices in voxel space, making alignment easier.
(11) Measurement: the user clicks two points in sequence in a slice view (or on the unified canvas), and the Euclidean distance between the two points in 3D voxel space is calculated. The unit may be voxels or normalized coordinates, but it must be identified in the UI. Display the measurement result text in the element with id="measurement" (for example, "12.3 vox").
(12) HUD: id="voxelValue" displays the current raw voxel intensity at the crosshair/intersection point. Whether the value is before or after mapping must be consistent and explicitly fixed in the description. Also display the current axial/coronal/sagittal slice numbers, either in separate elements or in the same HUD area.

[State Exposure (Required)]
window.__3D_STATE__ = {
  volumeSize: number,
  slicePositions: { axial: number, coronal: number, sagittal: number },
  windowWidth: number,
  windowCenter: number,
  colormap: string,
  volumeMode: boolean,
  voxelValue: number,
  measurementDistance: number
}

Requirements: volumeSize === 64; all three slicePositions fields must be integers within [0,63], or finite numbers consistent with the sliders; windowWidth∈[1,255], windowCenter∈[0,255]; colormap must be one of 'grayscale'|'hot'|'cool'; measurementDistance may be 0 before a measurement is made and must be > 0 after two valid clicks; voxelValue must be a finite number.

Output a single HTML file that runs when opened directly in a browser.
physics_constraints: Axial XY / Coronal XZ / Sagittal YZ PlaneGeometry + DataTexture
__3D_STATE__ volumeSize slicePositions windowWidth windowCenter colormap volumeMode voxelValue measurementDistance
